instruction: Look at freecad_task-7_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Machine the rectangular rail into a dovetail slide. Keep the 160 x 45 x 30 mm outside envelope. Cut a full-length centered dovetail slot open from the top: the slot runs along X for the entire 160 mm length, is centered at Y=22.5 mm, has top opening width 28 mm, bottom width 16 mm, and depth 14 mm so the slot floor is at Z=16 mm. Cut six vertical through holes of diameter 5.6 mm along the rail centerline at X=20,44,68,92,116,140 mm, all with Y=22.5 mm, and add a top counterbore of diameter 12 mm and depth 5 mm to each. Cut one shallow side relief groove into each long side face; each groove is 5 mm deep into the side face, 5 mm tall, runs the full 160 mm length, and is centered at Z=15 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-7_output.step. Work interactively in the GUI only; scripts are forbidden.
